hook.text: Your company wants to sell to banks. First, you need SOC 2 certification. Welcome to cloud compliance.

buildup.text: Compliance frameworks — SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA — define security standards your cloud setup must meet.

discovery.text: Cloud providers are pre-certified for many frameworks. But that only covers their part of shared responsibility.

twist.text: Being compliant doesn't mean being secure. Compliance is a minimum bar, not a guarantee against breaches.

climax.text: Smart companies use compliance as a starting point, then build security beyond what the framework requires.

punchline.text: Compliance opens doors. Real security keeps them safe.

quiz.question: Why doesn't compliance guarantee security?
options: Compliance is a minimum standard, not a comprehensive defense against all threats
Compliance frameworks are never updated for new threats
Cloud providers handle all compliance so customers don't need to worry

details.summary: Compliance frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and PCI DSS provide security standards that cloud environments must meet. Cloud providers achieve certifications for their infrastructure, but customers must ensure their own configurations and usage remain compliant.
details.whyItMatters: Regulatory non-compliance results in fines, legal liability, and loss of customer trust. Understanding which frameworks apply and how cloud shared responsibility affects compliance is essential.
takeaways: Provider certifications cover infrastructure, not customer usage
Customers must ensure their configurations meet compliance
Common frameworks include SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS

faq.question: Does using a compliant cloud provider make you compliant?
faq.answer: No. The provider's certification covers their infrastructure controls. You must still configure your environment correctly, manage access, encrypt data, maintain logs, and document your own compliance. The shared responsibility model applies fully to compliance.

faq.question: Which compliance framework is most common for cloud?
faq.answer: SOC 2 is the most common for SaaS companies and technology firms. HIPAA applies to healthcare data, PCI DSS to payment card data, and ISO 27001 is widely used internationally. Many organizations must comply with multiple frameworks simultaneously.
